correctness.rationale: Exact character orthogonality yields \(b_i b_j=b_{-i}\) iff \(j=-2i\). Left multiplication L_v has rank exactly Fourier support size, forcing all invertible algebra endomorphisms to be monomial. Multiplication of monomials yields the necessary-and-sufficient permutation/scalar constraints. Scalar orbit decomposition and centralizers of finite abelian H-sets prove the group presentation and cardinalities. Every nonstandard step is in RESULT.md; verify.py checked modular-arithmetic instances, including all centralizing permutations in degrees ≤9, 11-point order-33 witness and prime groups to 31. Finite tests are not promoted to an infinite proof.
